_comment: What `ecf upgrade` checks before it stops anything (SPEC §11.10; OD-375). tests/test_release.py keeps each field equal to the code: version to ecf.__version__, schema_version to the newest migration, data_format to export_bundle.DATA_FORMAT, api_version to api.API_VERSION, classifier_schema to the shipped schema's version (a change is a new gate for every address, OD-475), prompt_digest to classifier.prompt_digest of the shipped schema (likewise, Q6). min_client is the oldest ecf whose `ecf upgrade` may start this upgrade.
